scope: Current isolated DSH host input provenance and bounded content comparison; not independent human authentication.
expectations: One current own-turn user-source text message received through the normal prompt entry has actual host session/turn/start seq/message ID/message seq and the exact UTF-8 text hash.
Source selection comes from the execution agent session and a public projection, never a tool argument's source text/file/message ID/authority.

Synthetic context is never selected as the user source; unknown producer, inherited/closed-turn input, multiple ambiguous user candidates, missing agent/open turn, non-text and oversized input fail closed.
Host metadata identifies a message-content snapshot. It must not claim a raw log-file byte hash, startup file origin or independent human principal/signature.
Original D1 wrong facts/requirement direction are rejected against actual host input; an explicitly authored source-aligned view can match only as a deterministic fixture.
Reversed capability with a true current need must have the exact computed eligibility/requirement result, not merely an output containing an ID.
Native/PTC and default render are checked narrowly through the existing isolated host, with local deterministic transport and no real model requests.
